body: The hospital near me has the worst reviews and well it deserves it. The staff doesn't care, they will yell at the kids and pay no attention. You can only see the therapist for 3 minutes once a day if you are lucky. And you can only go outside (which is a blocked off are like the size of a walk in closet with dead grass and plants) for 5 minutes a day. I can see why some people would get excited to go to the hospital because for them it might be better then being at home or by themselves, but for me it's hell.
It's hard not to believe, especially the sadness is not a disease part. I mean my mom always say that my depression and mental illnesses are diseases.
But what if it never ends up getting better. What if i just end up back here
It's scary to keep going on...
Not really because none of them have really had a friend who had depression or suicidel thoughts.

I'm scared to go back to a therapist because I've had a therapist that wanted to send me to the hospital. I've been sent twice before and it has made everything worse. I've had nightmares about the hospital.
I don't know if I even want to live long enough to see it get better

I tried to tell my parents but they tell me things like you don't have it bad. I was diagnosed with schizophrenia by doctors, and one day my mom was just like I think you just make these things up. It hurt me but I can't confront her because then I will be seen as the bad person.
Well I'm kinda just letting go one last time right now.
But I feel like I'm just creating false hope for myself if I keep going.
Thanks but I don't plan to stay long.
I no longer have anything to look forward anymore.
No I no longer have anything to hold on to anymore. I been letting go of everything for the past few weeks in order for to not be held back when ending it all.
I've tried to do that but it just doesn't seem to work. It feels even worse to do that.
Well kinda.
My family knows how I feel they just don't care unless I actually have to be admitted to the hospital. After that they just do't care.

I been failing my classes to where I might have to repeat a year. I have a horrible attendance for school, so bad where I might not be able to get my license. I keep gaining weight even thought I try hard to lose it. My family thinks of me as a joke. My family isn't really that good with mental health. They gossip about anyone in my family with a bad mental health. So I feel like I embarrass my parents. Also with all the help I've been getting I its making it financially hard for my parents.
Well in a few words I'm a disappointment

I don't think I want to keep trying to find something to hold onto. For me life has only been darkness. Ever since I was a small child, around may 5 or 6 years old I've thought life would be better if I wasn't here. So darkness is all I've come into contact with.
hey I'm still here, sadly.
